name: Battery Pill
description:
A crisp, phone-style battery pill for the top bar, with the percentage inside.

Emerald with a bolt while charging, red at low battery, yellow in power saver and white otherwise. Vector-drawn, so it stays sharp at any scale. Event-driven through UPower and power-profiles-daemon, with no polling. Replaces the built-in battery icon cleanly and restores it when disabled.
